notes:
REF-BM-02: No remote metadata collection or metadata fields are implemented.
REF-BM-03: Titles are editable before and after saving, but descriptions and auto-collected metadata are absent.
REF-BM-04: URL, title, tags, and notes are editable, but there is no description field.
REF-BM-06: Duplicate URLs are detected, but the dialog permits creating another copy and does not guide the user into editing the existing bookmark.
REF-BM-07: Cards expose title and tags, but lack descriptions and favicons.
REF-BM-10: Tag entry has no autocomplete from existing tags.
REF-BM-12: Search covers title, URL, and notes, but no description field exists.
REF-BM-14: Search has no #tag syntax parser.
REF-BM-15: Boolean operators and parenthesised expressions are not parsed.
REF-BM-16: Quoted phrases receive no exact-match handling.
REF-BM-17: No unread/read-later state exists.
REF-BM-18: No unread-only view exists.
REF-BM-19: No mark-as-read action exists.
REF-BM-20: No multi-selection or bulk actions exist.
REF-BM-21: No whole-filtered-collection bulk action exists.
REF-BM-23: Notes can be written and displayed, but they are rendered as plain text rather than Markdown.
REF-BM-24: No local HTML snapshot or PDF preservation is implemented.
REF-BM-25: No Internet Archive snapshot support exists.
REF-BM-29: Bundles or reusable saved filters are not implemented.
REF-BM-30: Netscape HTML import is not implemented.
REF-BM-31: Netscape HTML export is not implemented.
REF-BM-32: Personal display settings are not implemented.
